mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${targetTable} (stock_code, period_key, date, open, high, low, close, pre_close, volume, amount) SELECT m.stock_code, #{periodKey}, m.last_date, o.open, m.high, m.low, c.close, o.pre_close, m.volume, m.amount FROM ( SELECT stock_code, MIN(date) AS first_date, MAX(date) AS last_date, MAX(high) AS high, MIN(low) AS low, SUM(volume) AS volume, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM ${sourceTable} WHERE date >= #{startDate} AND date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY stock_code ) m JOIN ${sourceTable} o ON o.stock_code = m.stock_code AND o.date = m.first_date JOIN ${sourceTable} c ON c.stock_code = m.stock_code AND c.date = m.last_date ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE date = VALUES(date), open = VALUES(open), high = VALUES(high), low = VALUES(low), close = VALUES(close), pre_close = VALUES(pre_close), volume = VALUES(volume), amount = VALUES(amount)
